name: Wagaya ni Majo ga Yattekita!
original_name: 我家に魔女がやって来た！
source:
Black witch Kiri is defeated in a magic war and expelled to human world. She can not use magic there unless establishes a contract with a human being - and that human happens to be our protagonist. Kiri only desires to return to her primary world and conduct revenge at first, but her heart gradually softens. However, two white witches are soon sent to the human world to kill Kiri...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
黑魔女基莉在魔法战争中落败，被驱逐到人类世界。除非与人类缔结契约，否则她无法在那里使用魔法——而与她订约的人恰好就是主人公。起初，基莉一心只想返回原来的世界复仇，内心却逐渐变得柔软。然而，两名白魔女很快也被派往人类世界，目标是杀死基莉……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
